scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-secrets.mjs && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:up: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; docker compose up -d'
scripts.db:down: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; docker compose down'
scripts.db:logs: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; docker compose logs -f'
scripts.db:reset: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; docker compose down -v'
scripts.supabase:start: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=local-dev-not-real npx supabase start'
scripts.supabase:stop: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=local-dev-not-real npx supabase stop'
scripts.supabase:status: sh -c '[ -S /var/run/docker.sock ] || export DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/$(id -u)/podman/podman.sock; SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=local-dev-not-real npx supabase status'
